title: Disney Mickey Mouse Coffee Mug Sketch Book Tea Cup Black White Large Collectible
descriptionText:
This collectible Disney Mickey Mouse coffee mug is a must-have for any fan of the iconic cartoon character. The mug features a unique sketch book design with the beloved Mickey Mouse character. It is perfect for tea or coffee and is a great addition to any Disneyana collection. The mug is contemporary, manufactured in the present era, and has not been modified. 

The mug is branded with the Disney franchise and is a great way to show off your love for the iconic character. This mug is perfect for collectors and fans of all ages. Add it to your collection today!
